description: SignalSumo connects your SEO account to ChatGPT. Ask about your tracked keyword positions and how they've moved, pull real Search Console queries, check a domain's backlink profile, see how often your brand appears in AI assistant answers, and start a technical site audit. Every answer comes from your own SignalSumo account under the same plan limits and quotas as the web app. Requires a SignalSumo account on a Pro or Agency plan.
